name: TC-337: /quote charges dealPrice × quantity (+ savings reported) and ignores the client's dealPrice
description: POST /api/order/:id/quote with the legacy checkout body template-wind sends. quote.deals[0] = {dealPrice 12, quantity 2, upcharge 0, lineTotal 24, savings 9}; dealsSubtotal 24 = subtotal. A tampered client dealPrice (0.01) changes nothing — server-authoritative pricing.
